title: Steady
why: The most common setup among self-serve launches still alive: ~85 SOL to graduate, a flat 1-3% fee, 100% of post-graduation liquidity permanently locked. Rule tested on an untouched holdout sample.

title: Anti-sniper (promising, not confirmed)
why: Same graduation and lock as Steady, but the fee starts at 50% and decays to 2% over the first 2 minutes so first-second bots pay heavily. Looked good on the discovery sample; the holdout had too few matching launches to confirm.
